name: Citizenship by Birth or Descent

qualifying_event.description: A person qualifies for Botswana citizenship, whether born inside or outside Botswana, if at the time of their birth either their father or their mother was a citizen of Botswana (Citizenship Act No. 8 of 1998).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; proof of the qualifying parent's Botswana citizenship (Omang or citizenship certificate).

requirements.blocker_text: The father or the mother was a citizen of Botswana at the time of the applicant's birth, regardless of whether the birth took place in or outside Botswana.

requirement_groups.name: Registration of a minor following a parent's naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: The Minister may register a person under 21 as a citizen where their father or mother has become a citizen of Botswana, on parental application.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying parent's Botswana citizenship (Omang or citizenship certificate)

sources.title: Citizenship Rights in Africa Initiative (private NGO advocacy archive) hosting Botswana's Citizenship Act No. 8 of 1998: citizenship by birth/descent from either parent (gender-neutral), dual-citizenship-must-choose-at-21 rule, renunciation and minor-registration provisions

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Botswana). STATUS: DRAFT -- the Citizenship Act text itself was only reachable via a private NGO advocacy site hosting a scanned PDF of the Act, not a gov.bw-hosted or Government Printer-published version (Botswana's own legislation portal was not reachable directly in this pass) -- treated as tier-3 per this dataset's convention that a non-government mirror of a real law's text, however accurate, is not tier-1 (see the Vietnam/luatvietnam precedent). Descent is explicitly gender-neutral -- either parent's citizenship suffices -- a genuine and notable contrast to Jordan's strictly patrilineal default (see jo_citizenship_by_descent.json). Both birth-in-Botswana and birth-abroad-to-a-citizen-parent are governed by the same clause per the source, so a single requirement group covers both rather than splitting them artificially. dual_citizenship_allowed is FALSE reflecting the Act's rule that a dual citizen must choose by age 21 or automatically lose Botswana citizenship, unless they take specific steps to retain it -- modeled as the general default outcome for someone taking no action, not as an absolute bar in every case (see notes on the Act's age-21 mechanism).
